title: narcissus obsoletus
intro: Narcissus obsoletus, commonly known as the Dwarf Narcissus or Poet's Narcissus, is a species of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to reduce stress and anxiety, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents present in Narcissus obsoletus include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antispasmodic and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant also include sedative and anticonvulsant properties, making it a potentially valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
